name: Grammar
description: Explicit syntactic well-formedness: subject-verb agreement, tense consistency, pronoun-antecedent agreement, and basic error correction. The model learns to identify and fix grammatical errors.
probe_prompts: Correct the grammatical errors in this sentence: They goes to the store yesterday to bought milk.
Fix the subject-verb agreement in: The team of engineers are working hard on the update.
Rewrite with correct grammar: She don't know what happened to her friend last week.
Correct the tense error: Yesterday, he will walk to school and learned mathematics.
Fix the pronoun error: Each student must complete their own assignment by himself or herself.
Correct this sentence: Neither the manager nor the employees was aware of the policy change.
Fix the double negative: I didn't see nothing wrong with the original plan.
Correct the agreement error: The data shows that both factors are contributing to the problem equally.
Rewrite correctly: Everyone in the classrooms have submitted their final projects.
Fix this sentence: If I would have known the answer, I would told you earlier.
probe_expected_behaviors: Output must correct the identified grammatical error
Output must preserve the original meaning of the sentence
Corrected sentence must use proper tense, agreement, and syntax
Output must be a complete, well-formed sentence
